description: This is a PHP class called BaseConfig that extends ArrayObject and provides methods to merge arrays, check for values, retrieve values with defaults, determine truthiness, and set values within a configuration context.

classes.name: BaseConfig
classes.description: A class that manages configuration data using array-like access, allowing merging, querying, and updating config values.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges an array of new values into the configuration, optionally overriding existing values.

methods.name: hasValue
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or returns a default if the key does not exist.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Determines if the value for a key exists and evaluates to true.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specific key to a given value in the configuration.
